name: Hermit / Heretic
life_theme: Develop natural genius in private, then be called upon as the practical problem-solver.
work_pattern: People project their hopes and solutions onto the 2/5. This creates a reputation that precedes them. Need significant solitude but will be called out repeatedly to solve others' problems.
career_approach: Develop expertise privately. Be selective about which calls you answer — you cannot help everyone. Build a reputation for practical problem-solving. Manage the projection that will come with visibility.
growth_edge: Managing the weight of others' projections without taking them personally.
